### No behaviour shift on lawful paths

The round adds one check line at the head of four functions. On an open transaction (`closed` unset or false), each
line is a no-op. `tx/tx.ts` sets `closed = true` only on its four closing paths (:137, :563, :613, :652, by grep). The
lawful callers are `insertChain.ts:202` (`applyAttraction`), `tx/ops.ts:123`, layout's `growth/{prune,boundary,proposals}.ts`,
`infill/bentCutFabric.ts:792` and `testkit/src/determinism/fixtures.ts:150` (`splitThrough`, which was already checked).
They all run inside an open batch. Receipts:

* step1-2 at the default sizes: 123 of 123.
* step1-2 under `PLAT_TINY_TABLES=1` (the `kernel-tiny` project, sentinel armed): 123 of 123.
* RELATED: no red that is the item's (below).

So there is no shift on any lawful path (CONFIRMED for the tested paths). No golden, digest or count moved.
